tasks.instruction: Option A: End on a lingering CU of the key in Dinu’s palm (hold on S16 insert then cut to S17 reaction), extending silence and rain ambience to heighten tension; keep Nimal off-screen after the handover. Option B: End on a two-shot pullback that reintroduces Nimal and shows the distance between them (use S19 two_shot then S21 insert anchor), adding a subtle rising low-string underscore as they part.

memory: Keep the shared rhythm and the way Nimal’s line lives in the master
